description: Search CRM objects of one type with HubSpot filter groups, with optional properties, sorts, and paging.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's response, to fetch the next page.

filterGroups.description: HubSpot filter groups defining the search criteria.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching objects to return in one page.

objectType.description: The CRM object type to search, such as contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

properties.description: Names of the properties to return for each matching object.

sorts.description: Property-based sort directives for ordering the search results.

name: hubspot_search_objects
